title: A Zero-shot Generalized Graph Anomaly Detection Framework via Node Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2606.12673v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cross-domain graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify abnormal nodes in unseen target graphs, showing strong potential in real-world applications with heterogeneous graph data. However, existing methods often depend on dataset-specific feature semantics and structural patterns, which limits their ability to generalize across different domains. To address this challenge, we propose AlignGAD, a zero-shot generalized graph anomaly detection framework. Our framework is built upon three key components: a Global Unification Module that aligns heterogeneous node features and normalizes graph signals in the spectral domain; a Clustering Module that constructs cluster-aware graph views to capture group-level abnormal patterns; and a Node Discrepancy Scoring Module that measures reconstruction discrepancy and aggregates anomaly evidence from different graph views. translated_title: 一种基于节点重构的零样本泛化图异常检测框架
translated_abstract: 跨域图异常检测（GAD）旨在识别未见过的目标图中的异常节点，在包含异构图数据的真实世界应用中展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法通常依赖于特定数据集的特征语义和结构模式，这限制了它们在不同领域之间的泛化能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了AlignGAD，一个零样本泛化图异常检测框架。我们的框架由三个关键组件构成：全局统一模块，用于对齐异构节点特征并在谱域中规范化图信号；聚类模块，用于构建聚类感知的图视图以捕捉群组级别的异常模式；以及节点差异评分模块，用于度量重构差异并聚合来自不同图视图的异常证据。在多个真实世界数据集上的实验证明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出了AlignGAD框架，通过全局特征统一、聚类感知图视图和节点重构差异评分三个模块，实现了无需目标域数据的零样本跨域图异常节点检测。
en_tdlr: AlignGAD is a zero-shot graph anomaly detection framework that detects abnormal nodes in unseen target graphs via node reconstruction, combining global feature unification, cluster-aware graph views, and node discrepancy scoring.
